title: Show HN: How we use AI agents for support in an open-source project (Seafile)
excerpt: Hi HN, i want to share my experience of using AI agents.
content_html:
Hi HN, i want to share my experience of using AI agents.

Background: Running an open-source project is no easy task. With a small team handling every issue means valuable time spend on searching for context and doing the right action.

Vision: I believe that well-designed software can revolutionize the way we approach work, enabling us to streamline processes, eliminate redundancies, and unlock new levels of creativity and focus.

What happened: SeaTicket was created for our own use, so my team can manage the support issues, easily and effectively. And when it showed that it has potential i decided to launch specifically for the open source community, so they can also resolve their support issues, without causing their team to have stuck on never ending search for context.

What it does: Brings all the context from all your tools, and give suggestions to what is the right action.

How it help: Duplicated Resolved issues, resolves in one click. new bugs are tracked by tickets.

How it differentiate: It has live knowledge(Github, Discord,Email and forum) and also the knowledge base.

Final thought: a missed support issue in github, will cause your community to loose the trust on the product and your team .

https://seaticket.ai/

content_html_zh:
你好，HN，我想分享一下我使用人工智能代理的经验。

背景：运行一个开源项目并不是一件容易的事。 由小团队处理每个问题意味着需要花费宝贵的时间来寻找背景并采取正确的行动。

愿景：我相信精心设计的软件可以彻底改变我们的工作方式，使我们能够简化流程、消除冗余并释放新的创造力和专注力。

发生了什么：SeaTicket 是为我们自己使用而创建的，因此我的团队可以轻松有效地管理支持问题。 当它显示出它的潜力时，我决定专门针对开源社区推出，这样他们也可以解决他们的支持问题，而不会导致他们的团队陷入永无止境的上下文搜索。

它的作用：从所有工具中获取所有背景信息，并就正确的操作提出建议。

它如何提供帮助：重复已解决的问题，一键解决。 新的错误通过票证进行跟踪。

它如何与众不同：它拥有实时知识（Github、Discord、电子邮件和论坛）以及知识库。

最后的想法：github 中错过的支持问题将导致您的社区失去对产品和团队的信任。

https://seaticket.ai/
